2: (() => {

7:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
8:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
9: 
10:   const player = { x: 50, y: H - 40, w: 30, h: 30, vy: 0, onGround: true };
11:   const obstacles = [];
12:   let speed = 4;
13:   let frame = 0;
14:   let gameOver = false;
15: 
16:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
17:     const gap = Math.random() * 120 + 80; // distance between obstacles
18:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20; // obstacle height
19:     const lastX = obstacles.length ? obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x : W;
20:     obstacles.push({ x: lastX + gap, w: 20, h: size });
21:   };
22: 
23:   const reset = () => {
24:     obstacles.length = 0;
25:     player.y = H - player.h;
26:     player.vy = 0;
27:     player.onGround = true;
28:     speed = 4;
29:     frame = 0;
30:     gameOver = false;
31:     spawnObstacle();
32:     loop();
33:   };
34: 
35:   const loop = () => {
36:     if (gameOver) return;
37:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
38: 
39:     // player physics
40:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
41:     player.y += player.vy;
42:     if (player.y >= H - player.h) {

44:       player.vy = 0;
45:       player.onGround = true;
46:     }
47:     // draw player

49:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
50: 
51:     // obstacles
52:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
53:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
54:       const o = obstacles[i];
55:       o.x -= speed;
56:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, H - o.h, o.w, o.h);
57: 
58:       // collision
59:       if (
60:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
61:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
62:         player.y + player.h > H - o.h
63:       ) {
64:         gameOver = true;
65:       }
66: 
67:       // remove passed obstacles
68:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
69:     }
70: 
71:     // spawn new obstacles
72:     if (frame % 100 === 0) spawnObstacle();
73:     frame++;
74:     speed += 0.001; // gradual speed increase
75: 
76:     if (gameOver) {
77:       ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
78:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
79:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 80, H / 2);
80:     } else {
81:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
82:     }
83:   };
84: 
85:   // input handling
86:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
87:     if (player.onGround && !gameOver) {
88:       player.vy = JUMP_SPEED;
89:       player.onGround = false;
90:     } else if (gameOver) {
91:       reset();
92:     }
93:   });
94: 
95:   // start
96:   reset();
97: })();
